_comment: Packages the scaffold installs. Names only, resolved to the current release at scaffold time. A floor appears only where the guideline relies on a feature or a known pitfall; the reason is in 'floors'.

allauth_extras._comment: django-allauth is always installed; the login audience adds extras (sso: company SSO via socialaccount's OpenID Connect provider, accounts: MFA with TOTP, passkeys and recovery codes).

node._comment: The frontend tooling (Vue, Router, Pinia, TypeScript, ESLint+Oxlint, Vitest, Playwright) comes from create-vue at scaffold time; this section only adds or adjusts on top of it.

floors.django-vite>=3: The DJANGO_VITE settings dict and {% vite_asset %} tags used by the templates arrived in 3.x.
floors.psycopg[binary]>=3: psycopg2 is in maintenance; Django and the guideline use psycopg 3.
floors.sqlalchemy[asyncio]>=2: The realtime service uses the 2.0 typed ORM (Mapped, mapped_column) and async engine.
floors.pydantic-settings>=2: Settings moved out of pydantic core in v2.
floors.mkdocs>=1.6,<2: MkDocs 2.0 is reported to drop plugins and themes; Material itself requires mkdocs<2. Material reaches end of life on 2026-11-05: see the docs-site pitfall in fullstack-engineering/references/local-dev-and-tooling.md.
floors.@playwright/test (exact): The Playwright Docker image tag must equal the installed @playwright/test version, so it is installed without a range.

runtimes._comment: Defaults for base images, set once at scaffold time and overridable. Rules, re-check at scaffold time: python = newest minor that every core package officially supports (Celery is usually last); node = current Active LTS; postgres = current major with at least one year of minor releases; redis = current stable major (Redis 8 offers AGPLv3 among its licenses; running the official image as a service is fine); debian = suite pinned on purpose, because the `-slim` tags switch suites on their own. caddy = current major (local/CI proxy that mirrors production routing); mailpit = current major tag (development mail catcher, accounts audiences only). docker = current Docker major (GitLab CI docker:<v>-cli / -dind images).

pitfalls.typescript: `typescript@latest` can be ahead of Vue tooling (vue-tsc, typescript-eslint). Use the TypeScript line create-vue currently generates.
pitfalls.pnpm: Recent pnpm blocks dependency build scripts by default: approve the ones you need (`pnpm approve-builds`). Corepack is removed from Node 25 on: install the exact pnpm from `packageManager` explicitly.
pitfalls.fastapi: FastAPI is still 0.x and ships breaking changes in minor releases: always install from the lockfile and read the release notes before upgrading.
pitfalls.sqlalchemy: Adopt a new SQLAlchemy minor only after a test window; the project itself advises pinning below a fresh minor until tested.
